**Boundaries.** A nop is not a substitute for an ordering operation: it does not make a preceding write visible to a following read and does not wait for outstanding traffic. Whether the hardware treats a run of nops as free or as consumed issue slots is UNRESOLVED. Whether a nop at the end of a shader body is reachable, and what happens when control reaches the end of the body without an explicit termination, is UNRESOLVED.
